title: Automated role attestation and SSO traceback for residency-bound datasets
creator: Ava Chen
description: Goal: Build an automated pipeline that ties RBAC/SCIM role snapshots and SSO assertion traces to residency-tagged datasets so we can produce tamper-evident access attestation bundles for audits. Background: Customers in regulated regions require proof that only approved principals had access to data stored in a given residency region for a specified window. Current process is manual: ops run ad-hoc SCIM exports, query logs, and assemble reports. This ticket scopes a pragmatic, production-safe automation that integrates SSO assertion traces (SAML/OIDC), the SCIM role reconciliation stream, and residency metadata from the tenant catalog, then emits per-tenant per-period evidence artifacts and searchable audit indices.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible pipeline produces a signed evidence bundle for a tenant and date-range containing: SCIM role snapshot, SSO assertion traces for role changes and logins, residency metadata, and a checksum manifest.
Evidence bundles are stored in an immutable S3 path (or equivalent) with lifecycle and access audit logging enabled.
Compliance console UI shows an evidence artifact entry with generation timestamp, constituent artifacts, and a download link.
Automated notification (email + Slack) is sent to the tenant security contact and internal compliance channel when a bundle for a residency-bound dataset is generated or requested.
End-to-end tests validate that a simulated role revocation in SCIM plus a later SSO login produces the correct timeline in the evidence bundle.
Pipeline meets SLA: generation for a 90-day window for a mid-size tenant completes within 10 minutes in 95% of runs.
Security review sign-off obtained and key material used for signing is KMS-backed and audit-logged.
tasks: Design: finalize artifact schema (manifest format, fields, signing metadata). Confluence draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/COM/Role+Attestation+Artifacts
Infra: provision immutable storage path and lifecycle policy; grant read-only audit role for compliance team.
Data: extend tenant catalog to surface 'residency_tag' on dataset objects and create a residency-indexed view for the pipeline.
SCIM: wire SCIM delta stream consumer and create canonical role snapshot generator (per-tenant, per-period).
SSO: implement SAML/OIDC assertion tailing job that extracts assertion metadata (principal, roles, ip, timestamp) and correlates with role snapshots.
Orchestration: implement a Dagster workflow that assembles artifacts, computes checksums, signs manifest via KMS, and writes bundle to immutable path.
Console: add evidence artifact list card, preview modal, and download endpoint that verifies signature before serving.
Notifications: integrate with notifications service for tenant contact and #compliance Slack channel.
Testing: add unit tests for manifest generator, integration tests for SCIM+SSO correlation, and load test for 90-day window pipeline SLA.
Docs & runbook: author operator runbook and customer-facing FAQ for requesting ad-hoc bundles.
risks: Performance risk: SSO assertion store may be large; tailing job must support efficient windowed queries. Mitigation: use indexed append-only store (Kafka or OLAP) and pre-aggregate assertion counts.
Data completeness: transient SCIM failures could cause missing role snapshots. Mitigation: add retries, tombstone handling, and reconcile job that backfills gaps.
Privacy: evidence bundles contain PII (usernames, ip). Mitigation: default redaction policy for public bundles; access gated by tenant ACLs and encryption at rest.
Signing key management: key compromise would invalidate attestations. Mitigation: use KMS with rotation and limited operator access; include key version in manifest.
rollout_plan: Alpha (internal): run pipeline nightly for 5 internal tenants; validate artifact contents and console UX.
Beta: enable per-request bundle generation for a small set of pilot customers with legal approval.
GA: open to enterprise customers with residency requirements; document SLA and pricing for on-demand generation.
Fallback: if orchestration fails, provide a guided manual export path with BCP to support audit requests within 48 hours.
testing_plan: Unit tests for manifest generation and signature verification.
Integration tests: simulate SCIM role changes and SSO logins; assert timeline order in bundle.
E2E test harness that runs the pipeline for a synthetic tenant with 90 days of events and measures runtime and artifact correctness.
Security test: key rotation simulation and verification that old bundles remain verifiable.
Load test: generate bundles for 100 concurrent mid-size tenants and verify 95th percentile latency.
